base:
Charter of the Tidewater Commons DAO
Members: anyone holding at least one COMMONS token is a member.
Proposals: any member may post a proposal to the forum for a vote.
Quorum: a vote is valid only if at least 10 percent of all tokens take part.
Majority: a proposal passes when more than half of the votes cast are in favour.
Execution: a passed proposal is executed as soon as the vote closes.
Voting period: every vote stays open for 5 days.
Council: three elected stewards publish a treasury report every month.
Treasury: a single proposal may spend at most 5,000 GEN.
Amendments: this charter changes only through a proposal that passes under these rules.
Conduct: members settle disputes in the public forum.
This charter took effect on 1 September 2026.
mandates: Raise the quorum from 10 percent to 15 percent.
Add a 48-hour delay between a vote passing and its execution.
